title: The page-item checks run on triage's own page writes
why: Owner, page comment 13:18 CST Nov 7, on item 350: "what is this error and why does it happen so often". The card showed "This item carries a field the page does not draw." Triage wrote `link`, a field outside the page's itemFields list (`links` is the field). Six items carried it. question_form.item_field_hit refuses `link` when called directly (read 13:28 CST), yet none of triage's writes was refused.
note:
13:28 CST Nov 7: the lane proved the cause. Triage converted the seven `link` items on the page to `links` (all closed items) at 13:33 CST.
Likely cause, read but not proven: page_item_hit runs the full item checks only when the write's url is the cwd repo's page key. Triage writes from the roadmap worktree or /home/user, where no page key is read, so only the none-key check runs (hooks/question_form.py, the comment above option_letter_hit's caller: "the page cannot be named reliably"). The one page writer is the session the checks miss. Fix the cause: read the page key from the session's cs-repo tag or the claude-settings checkout, not the cwd. Done: a red test where a page write from a cwd with no page key and an unlisted field is refused, then green; the six `link` items fixed or closed. Coordinator, 14:10 CST Nov 7: gap rework-reply-set-unjudged also goes to this lane, which owns the file. Sighting 05:05 CST Nov 8: triage wrote item 411 with a widening option a as the pick; the style-question-form hook flagged it only at the next prompt, and triage rewrote it at version 2. A page-write check would have refused it before the write. Sighting 11:14 CST Nov 8: triage posted item 432 with a widening option as the pick and no ruling line; the lane caught it.
